mapper.select: SELECT role_code FROM iam_role WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_code = #{appCode}
SELECT menu_code, parent_code, menu_name, icon, menu_type, route_path, component, button_code, hidden, sort FROM iam_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_code = #{appCode} ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT rm.role_code, rm.menu_code FROM iam_role_menu rm INNER JOIN iam_role r ON r.role_code = rm.role_code AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE rm.deleted = 0 AND r.app_code = #{appCode}
SELECT api_code, api_method, api_uri FROM iam_api WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_code = #{appCode}

SELECT ma.menu_code, ma.api_code FROM iam_menu_api ma INNER JOIN iam_menu m ON m.menu_code = ma.menu_code AND m.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN iam_api a ON a.api_code = ma.api_code AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE ma.deleted = 0 AND m.app_code = #{appCode}
SELECT api_code, field_code, field_name, json_path, action, mask_rule FROM iam_api_field WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_code = #{appCode} ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT api_code, api_method, api_uri, request_control FROM iam_api WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_code = #{appCode} AND request_control IS NOT NULL AND request_control != ''
SELECT role_code FROM iam_user_role WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_code = #{userCode} AND enable_status = 1 AND (start_time IS NULL OR start_time <= NOW()) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= NOW())
